skills.name: Service fingerprinting
skills.description: Identify services precisely after a scan.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. net.portscan to find open ports.
2. Grab banners with process.exec (nc/curl as appropriate).
3. Match versions via web.search.
4. Record OS hints from TTLs where visible.
5. Update the service map.

skills.name: Default credential checks
skills.description: Verify default credentials on owned devices.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. List the service's documented defaults (web.search).
2. Attempt only on your own/lab systems.
3. Log attempts and outcomes.
4. Change any default found immediately.
5. Report the finding.

skills.name: FTP service assessment
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Banner grab (process.exec).
2. Test anonymous login on authorized hosts.
3. List and inspect shared files (read-only).
4. Note writable dirs cautiously.
5. Report exposure.

skills.name: SMB enumeration
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Check guest/session access on authorized hosts (process.exec tools).
2. List shares; note permissions.
3. Sample file listings read-only.
4. Flag open shares.
5. Report with remediation.

skills.name: SMTP user enumeration
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Use VRFY/EXPN/RCPT probing on your own mail server.
2. Measure response differences (python.run_file).
3. List confirmed users if enumeration works.
4. Report the enumeration vector.
5. Recommend uniform responses.

skills.name: DNS zone assessment
skills.description: Check zone transfer and record hygiene.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Attempt AXFR against authorized NS (process.exec dig).
2. Enumerate common records.
3. Flag zone transfer if allowed.
4. Verify with a second method.
5. Report DNS hygiene.

skills.name: RDP exposure review
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Confirm port exposure (net.portscan).
2. Check NLA/enforcement banners (process.exec).
3. Note exposure to untrusted networks.
4. Recommend gateway/VPN-only access.
5. Record the review.

skills.name: SSH configuration review
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Banner grab and note algorithms offered (process.exec ssh -Q probes).
2. Check root login/password auth policy via config reads where authorized.
3. Recommend modern algorithms and key-only auth.
4. Verify after changes.
5. Document the review.

skills.name: Database exposure review
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. net.portscan for 3306/5432/1433/27017.
2. Confirm they require auth (benign connect probes).
3. Never brute production credentials.
4. Recommend network ACLs.
5. Record exposure.

skills.name: IoT device audit
skills.description: Audit smart devices on the LAN.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. system.app_list/process_list for device apps.
2. port scan the device (authorized).
3. Check default creds and open Telnet (process.exec probes).
4. Firmware notes via web.search.
5. Report per-device findings.

skills.name: Router configuration review
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Login to the admin UI (user provides access).
2. Review WAN management, UPnP, DNS settings.
3. Test default creds explicitly denied.
4. Update firmware if user approves.
5. Summarize changes.

skills.name: LAN inventory
skills.description: Map devices on the local network.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Scan the local /24 politely (process.exec nmap-like or arp).
2. Resolve names; fingerprint MAC vendors (python.run_file).
3. Flag unknown devices.
4. Record the inventory.
5. Report anomalies.

skills.name: Wi-Fi security review
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Check supported auth modes via device UI (androidreadscreen).
2. Note WPA2/WPA3 usage.
3. Test guest isolation if permitted.
4. Recommend WPA3 + strong PSK.
5. Record the review.

skills.name: VPN endpoint review
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Port scan for VPN ports (net.portscan).
2. Banner/ike probes (process.exec).
3. Check for exposed admin panels (web.headervuln).
4. Recommend MFA and gateway hardening.
5. Document.

skills.name: Proxy service audit
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Identify proxy ports (net.portscan).
2. Test open-relay behavior on owned hosts (process.exec curl via proxy).
3. Flag open proxies.
4. Recommend auth/ACLs.
5. Record.

skills.name: Service version advisories
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Fingerprint versions (cat_nx_service_fingerprint).
2. Query NVD by CPE (cat_res_nvd_query).
3. List applicable CVEs with severity.
4. Note exploit availability (cat_res_exploitdb_search).
5. Prioritize remediation.

skills.name: MITM lab methodology
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Build the lab: your AP/proxy + test client (file.write plan).
2. Verify interception with http.capture.
3. Practice TLS inspection on your own traffic.
4. Document lessons.
5. Never apply to third-party traffic.

skills.name: Pivot awareness (authorized)
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Map reachable segments from a foothold (authorized only).
2. Enumerate services via the pivot (benign probes).
3. Document the technique, not damage.
4. Keep changes reversible.
5. Report the path with fixes.

skills.name: Firewall rule review
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Collect rules (authorized: process.exec or UI).
2. Flag any-any or stale rules (python.run_file).
3. Propose tightened ruleset.
4. Verify after changes.
5. Summarize.

skills.name: IDS alert triage
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Correlate alerts with your test timeline (python.run_file).
2. Classify true test signals vs noise.
3. Feed back tuning suggestions.
4. Record in engagement notes.
5. Report coverage gaps.

skills.name: Network assessment report
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Combine: hosts, services, vulns, misconfigs.
2. Evidence per finding (banners, scans).
3. Severity-ranked remediation.
4. Redact sensitive strings.
5. file.write and summarize.

skills.name: Wi-Fi capture lab
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Capture only your own AP/clients (tcpdump.capture).
2. Analyze handshake presence (not cracking).
3. Study frame types.
4. Document lessons.
5. Keep within law.

skills.name: Bluetooth posture (self devices)
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. List paired devices via settings UI (androidclickelement).
2. Remove unknown pairs (with user approval).
3. Check discoverability state.
4. Record hygiene steps.
5. Report.

skills.name: NFC relay awareness
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Explain relay attack preconditions.
2. Map your NFC use cases (payments, badges).
3. Recommend protection options.
4. No live relay testing on third-party systems.
5. Summarize.

skills.name: Abuse guardrails
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. No DDoS, no amplification, no scanning of third parties.
2. Keep volume tiny and targeted.
3. Monitor your own impact (http.capture).
4. Stop on any owner request.
5. Document compliance.
